# Attach to the intended document

- An attachment belongs to a resource and insertion position. Save and reopen the same resource to inspect its persisted reference.
- Delayed operations must retain their intended target or ask you to retarget; current focus alone is not consent to change destinations.

**Offline asset specification:** blue-square.png, 16 × 16 pixels, fully opaque blue; original first-party practice asset, MIT; alt text `Solid blue square`. No generated file or real upload is claimed here.

**Trace:** paste begins in Review revision 1 at the end. While processing, focus moves to Details. The safe outcome is cancellation or explicit retargeting, not silent insertion into Details. A separate successful receipt names Review revision 2, attachment blue-square.png, alt text above; reopening Review retains that reference.

A reference surviving reopening is not proof that another user has permission to fetch the underlying file.
